description: Election Commission - Resathurai Rajkumar was Selected as the member of the Point Pedro Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Point Pedro Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
